name: Deep Space Recovery Vessel L-2783
description: The Deep Space Recovery Vessel L-2783, or simply the L-2783, was a class of bulk cruiser manufactured by Corellian Engineering Corporation that was designed to travel to remote locations to repair or recover damaged starships. At least one L-2783 was owned by the Alliance to Restore the Republic, which served as the flagship of a small flotilla of starfighters and corvettes.

data.name: Deep Space Recovery Vessel L-2783
armament: Ventral mounted heavy industrial tractor beam
data.capacity: Roughly half that of a Action VI transport
